净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Long-term trend cycle position: Measures distance of price from 200-day SMA normalized by 20-day ATR. High positive values indicate overextended uptrend, negative values indicate oversold downtrend, capturing cyclical mean-reversion in market phases. Cross-sectional ranking allows comparison of deviation across stocks.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-((close - ts_mean(200, close)) / ts_atr(20))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-((close - ts_mean(200, close)) / ts_atr(20))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ts_mean(close) → 窗口 200 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  2. 步骤2：subtract(close, v1(ts_mean)) → 减法：x - y
  3. 步骤3：subtract(high, low) → 减法：x - y
  4. 步骤4：subtract(high, pre_close) → 减法：x - y
  5. 步骤5：abs(v4(subtract)) → 计算绝对值
  6. 步骤6：subtract(low, pre_close) → 减法：x - y
  7. 步骤7：abs(v6(subtract)) → 计算绝对值
  8. 步骤8：maximum(v5(abs), v7(abs)) → 逐点取两序列较大值
  9. 步骤9：maximum(v3(subtract), v8(maximum)) → 逐点取两序列较大值
  10. 步骤10：ts_mean(v9(maximum)) → 窗口 20 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  11. 步骤11：divide(v2(subtract), v10(ts_mean)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  12. 步骤12：neg(v11(divide)) → 返回-x

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 high：high
  3. 计算 low：low
  4. 计算 sma200：close.滚动窗口(200, min_periods=200).mean()
  5. 计算 tr：pd.concat([high - low, (high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs(), axis=1).max(axis=1)
  6. 计算 atr20：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  7. 计算 position：(close - sma200) / atr20
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_trend_cycle_position(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] high = df_copy["high"] low = df_copy["low"] "com"># long-term SMA sma200 = close.rolling(200, min_periods=200).mean() "com"># ATR20 tr = pd.concat([high - low, (high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr20 = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() "com"># position position = (close - sma200) / atr20.replace(0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_trend_cycle_position"] = position "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_trend_cycle_position"]
